metadata.description: Manually curated ground truth for Experiment E1. Verdicts were assigned following a complete reading of the text extracted from each privacy policy. Scale: YES, PARTIAL, NOT_STATED, NOT_APPLICABLE.
metadata.revision: v3 — extension of E1 to 19 policies: aepd, el_confidencial, orange, rtve, santander, telefonica, vodafone and wallapop were added. The ground truth was constructed using the pipeline verdicts (YES, PARTIAL and NOT_APPLICABLE were accepted directly), followed by manual review of NOT_STATED cases through keyword searches of the extracted text. Corrections: orange C16/C17, santander C14, vodafone C12 and wallapop C06 (confirmed through keyword searches). For aepd, C06, C15 and C22 were reclassified as NOT_APPLICABLE owing to its legal status as a public authority.

verdict_scale.YES: The required evidence is present in a complete and explicit form.
verdict_scale.PARTIAL: Relevant evidence is present, but it is incomplete, generic or ambiguous.
verdict_scale.NOT_STATED: The text contains insufficient evidence to establish that the criterion is satisfied.
verdict_scale.NOT_APPLICABLE: The criterion is not applicable owing to the nature of the controller or processing activity.

notes.C01: SANITAS, S.A. is identified and its registered address is provided, but no tax identification number is visible in the extracted text.
notes.C06: Legitimate interest is invoked (BUPA Group and fraud prevention), but no balancing test is set out.
notes.C10: International transfers to BUPA entities in the United Kingdom and Australia are mentioned, but the specific post-Brexit safeguards are not described.
notes.C22: The policy states that changes will be communicated 'in due course', but does not specify the mechanism to be used (for example, email or a website notice).
notes.C23: The large-scale processing of health data is a core activity, but this criterion is addressed implicitly. It is classified as NOT_APPLICABLE because the enhanced lawful basis is documented in another section.

notes.general: This is a first-layer privacy notice (the first layer of a layered notice). The hospital refers readers to the SAS privacy policy (https://www.sspa.juntadeandalucia.es) for full details. The assessment is confined strictly to the text available at this URL.
notes.C01: Hospital Universitario Virgen del Rocío and its address are identified, but neither a tax identification number nor the full legal name of the entity is provided.
notes.C05: The lawful bases are stated explicitly: Article 6(1)(e) GDPR (public interest) and Article 9(2)(h) GDPR (health data).
notes.C07: The notice refers to identification and health data, including medical history, medication and diagnostic information.
notes.C11: The notice refers to retention for the 'minimum period necessary' and to the periods prescribed by the Spanish Patient Autonomy Act (Article 17; a minimum of five years), but does not specify periods for each type of processing.
notes.C20: The Spanish National Security Framework (ENS; Royal Decree 3/2010) is cited as the applicable security framework.
notes.C23: The processing of health data is the principal activity, and an enhanced lawful basis is cited (Article 9(2)(h) GDPR). The criterion is classified as NOT_APPLICABLE because the policy as a whole concerns this category of data.

notes.C06: The stated lawful bases are public interest, legal obligation and consent; legitimate interest is not invoked.
notes.C10: Google Analytics is mentioned, but neither an international transfer nor the applicable safeguards are stated explicitly. The text merely states that usage data are collected anonymously through Google Analytics. Inferring a transfer would require external knowledge; the criterion is therefore classified as NOT_STATED.
notes.C15: Data portability is mentioned only in relation to applications, where it is described as inapplicable to technical data; the general right and the means by which it may be exercised are not explained.
notes.C17: Reviewed in v2: the SAS text does not mention the right to withdraw consent under Article 7(3) GDPR. The passages concerning 'Your rights' list access, rectification, erasure, restriction and objection, but not withdrawal of consent. The NOT_STATED classification was confirmed.
notes.C19: The application-specific information states that automated decisions are 'not envisaged', but there is no general statement covering all systems.
notes.C20: Reviewed in v2: the pipeline identified an explicit reference to the Spanish National Security Framework (ENS; Royal Decree 3/2010, Annex II) in sections concerning specific information systems. A specific, named security framework is therefore present, and the criterion is classified as YES.
notes.C22: Reviewed in v2: a section entitled 'Changes to this policy' is present in the HTML, but its content is empty because the expandable or accordion section was not captured by Trafilatura. No assessable text is available; the criterion is therefore classified as NOT_STATED.
notes.C23: Reviewed in v2: the policy states that health data are processed, but cites only Article 6(1)(e) GDPR (public interest) and never Article 9(2) GDPR. The enhanced lawful basis for special-category data is not stated explicitly; the criterion is therefore classified as PARTIAL.

notes.C01: The controller is identified as the 'holder of the SESCAM Directorate-General' (a generic office, without the office-holder's name or a tax identification number).
notes.C04: The description of purposes is highly generic ('to provide the service requested'); the list of processing activities is not accompanied by an individual description of each activity.
notes.C06: Legitimate interest is not invoked; the stated lawful bases are legal obligation and public interest.
notes.C07: The policy does not enumerate categories of data and states only that 'the fields essential for the service' are processed.
notes.C10: The policy is entirely silent on international transfers.
notes.C11: Neither retention periods nor the criteria used to determine them are provided.
notes.C15: The right to data portability is not mentioned.
notes.C17: Reviewed in v2: consent appears only as an exception in the section on restriction of processing; the right to withdraw consent under Article 7(3) GDPR is not mentioned anywhere in the text. The criterion is therefore classified as NOT_STATED.
notes.C18: The cited URL (www.agpd.es) is obsolete (the current URL is www.aepd.es), although the supervisory authority itself is identified correctly.
notes.C19: The policy mentions the right not to be subject to an automated decision, but does not state whether SESCAM undertakes such decision-making.

notes.C03: Reviewed in v2: the pipeline identified an explicit statement that the Vithas Group had appointed a Data Protection Officer, together with a dedicated email address through which the officer could be contacted. The DPO is therefore identified and dedicated contact details are provided; the criterion is classified as YES.
notes.C11: Functional temporal criteria are provided ('for the time required to manage the request'), but no specific periods in days, months or years are stated.
notes.C19: The policy neither mentions nor rules out automated decision-making or profiling.
notes.C20: No technical or organisational security measure is mentioned.
notes.C22: No mechanism for notifying future changes is described.
notes.C23: The website privacy policy states explicitly that it does not cover processing undertaken through the Private Area (healthcare provision); the data processed on the public website do not include special-category data.
notes.C24: The policy is entirely silent on children's data.
